x.votes: Who votes. Residents include children, non-citizens and people who are not registered; a district's people are not its electorate.
x.year: This year's population. The count is as of April 1, 2020, the day the lines were drawn on; the survey figures are five-year averages centred on 2022.
x.exact: Exactness. Every survey figure has a margin (±); a small district's margins are wide, and two districts whose margins overlap may not differ at all.
x.fair: Fairness or intent. Equal population is a legal requirement, and a spread inside the range courts accept is not a finding of fairness, nor one outside it a finding of wrongdoing; the courts weigh the reasons. Nothing here says who was placed where, or why.
x.adjusted: Adjusted counts. Some states draw their lines on a count adjusted for where people in prison lived before; the Bureau's count here is unadjusted, so those states' districts look less equal than under the count they used.
